page.title: Measures
page.purpose: Render this scenario's declared measures — the same typed, parameterized queries search-hub answers from a natural-language question. Not a bespoke analytics surface; the presentation layer over a contract that already exists.

priorities.notes: A measure shows the window it covers and the population it counted. An unmeasured surface reports unavailable with a reason, never zero — the same honesty contract the readiness board holds.
Fetched versus materialized across the corpus is the measure that says whether this scenario is working at all. Session and program counts are inventory; they lead nowhere.

priorities.statement: The page shows declared measures and nothing else.
priorities.notes: If a number is worth showing here it is worth declaring in the CLI manifest, where search-hub can match it and any caller can query it. A chart with no declared measure behind it is a local analysis stack by another name.

priorities.statement: A domain with no measure says so.
priorities.notes: A waived domain shows its waiver and reason. Silence would read as coverage.

states.description: Declared measures render with their current values and stated basis.
No measure has produced data yet — typically a fresh install with no programs.
Some measures resolved and others are unavailable; each unavailable one states why.
Results are from a cached snapshot and the snapshot age is shown.
Measures could not be computed and the reason is visible.

elements.name: Context avoided
elements.description: Fetched versus materialized across the corpus — the scenario's thesis metric.

elements.name: Declared measures
elements.description: One entry per measure declared in the CLI manifest, with its intent and result kind.

elements.name: Measure result
elements.description: Scalar, table, or series, rendered per the measure's declared result kind.

elements.name: Basis
elements.description: The window, population, and parameters the result was computed over.

elements.name: Measure unavailable
elements.description: States why a measure could not be computed, in place of a zero.

elements.name: Waived domain
elements.description: A domain intentionally carrying no measure, with the declared reason.

elements.name: Binding coverage
elements.description: Bound against total operation classes — the same registry state the Act numerator reports.

claims.statement: The page exposes a named measures region containing the declared measure list.
Context avoided is the visually dominant element on the page.
No measure result renders without the window and population it was computed over.
claims.rationale: A number without a basis cannot be checked, and this console's voice contract requires every number to be falsifiable.

claims.statement: A measure that could not be computed reports unavailable with a reason and never renders as zero.
claims.rationale: Zero is a measurement. Reporting an absence as zero is the exact failure the readiness board's denominator-confidence model exists to prevent.

claims.statement: A stateful domain carrying no measure appears with its waiver and reason rather than being omitted.
claims.rationale: OT-P0-009. An omitted domain is indistinguishable from a covered one, which defeats the point of grading coverage.

claims.statement: Every value on this page traces to a measure declared in the CLI manifest.
claims.rationale: An undeclared chart is unreachable by search-hub and by any other caller, and constitutes the scenario-local analysis stack this scenario does not build.

claims.statement: Loading, empty, partial, stale, and error states each render dedicated content.
The measure list and every measure result are reachable by keyboard alone.
